draft.heroMessage: Honest. Informed. On Your Side in Portland Real Estate.
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome—I'm Gavin Shettler, your dedicated Portland real estate broker. My approach is rooted in transparency and thoughtful communication, ensuring you always feel supported, informed, and confident.
draft.tagline: Building lasting relationships, one home at a time.
draft.aboutParagraph: Serving Portland, Oregon and surrounding areas, I believe real estate is about more than transactions—it’s about shaping communities and creating meaningful relationships. I bring you experience as a certified Earth Advantage Broker, Energy Trust Ally, and ADU Specialist, with a passion for high efficiency homes and green technology. Whether buying, selling, or considering an ADU, I’ll be your advisor and advocate every step of the way.
draft.conciergeLine: Looking for guidance on efficient homes or adding more space? I specialize in sustainability and creative living solutions.
draft.contactLine: Ready to start your journey? Let’s connect at (509) 219-9672.
draft.tone: Welcoming, transparent, and knowledgeable—with a focus on personalized guidance and sustainability.

sections.title: The best homes deserve the best agents
sections.body: Redfin Premier agents are local luxury experts with years of experience buying and selling high-end homes. Only our best agents qualify to become Redfin Premier agents. When you're ready to buy, your agent will know what it takes to write a winning offer for the most highly sought-after homes. And when it's time to sell, they will know how to price, prepare, and market your home, so it attracts qualified buyers and sells for top dollar.

sections.title: Meet Gavin's Team
sections.body: When you work with Redfin, one agent is responsible for your success, but you really get a whole team. Redfin agents work closely with a team of real estate professionals to ensure every sale closes without a hitch. FROM THE SITE
Key takeaways
Selling your house may be the right option if you need the proceeds to purchase your next home or you plan to move permanently. Renting out your house may be the right option if you plan to live in your home again, have a low mortgage rate, or want to generate rental income. Your local housing and rental markets, financial situation, and long-term goals are major factors in deciding whether to sell or rent out your house. Deciding whether to sell or rent out your house can be complicated in today’s housing market.
ABOUT
About Gavin
I am a residential real estate broker serving Portland, Oregon and the surrounding areas. My clients love working with me for my honesty, integrity, and good communication. Real estate is more than just buying or selling a home, it’s about building authentic and lasting relationships between individuals, families, neighborhoods, and communities. My role as your agent includes facilitator, negotiator, advocate, advisor, and expert in the Portland Metro housing market.
